B. $1+\frac{1}{2}\ln 5$. C. $1+\ln 3$. D. $\frac{1}{2}\left(1+\ln 3 \right)$.⏎Chọn A. Ta có $F\left(x \right)=\int f\left(x \right)\mathrm{d}x=\int \frac{\mathrm{d}x}{2x+1}=\frac{1}{2}\ln \left| 2x+1 \right|+C$.⏎$F\left(0 \right)=1\Leftrightarrow\frac{1}{2}\ln 1+C=1\Leftrightarrow C=1\Rightarrow F\left(x \right)=\frac{1}{2}\ln \left| 2x+1 \right|+1\Rightarrow F\left(-2 \right)=1+\frac{1}{2}\ln 3$.
